title: From field to fragrance: Givaudan's House of Naturals is taking shape in Grasse
summary: In early 2028, at Grasse Campus 52, Givaudan will inaugurate a Center of Excellence dedicated to innovation and to the production of natural raw materials. Spreading across 2.7 hectares, the new site will represent the centrepiece of House of Naturals, a program designed to highlight the group's expertise in natural ingredients.
